title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 13.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 allowed authenticated users with Maintainer role permissions to cause a denial of service. The issue was due to missing server-side input validation on on-call rotation values. This flaw has been remediated by GitLab in the specified fixed versions.
